ademp.aims: what the pooled affine intercept a, slope b, crossover b/a, slope ratio b/b_P and thinning rate c recover on the real R_A design, under generators that differ in transmission heterogeneity, offspring dispersion, reporting and reporting shocks
ademp.data_generating_mechanisms: eleven generators S0-S8 (meta.generators) on the frozen 1,748-row R_A design with shared counts; count scale tuned to the observed median retained count; heterogeneity amplitude tuned to the observed a (see scenarios.*.calibration); S8 transmission-share grid in ma_audit_extra.json
ademp.estimands: transmission relative variance of R_i on retained rows (v_R); total relative variance v_R + v_H, where v_H is the current-value error caused by reporting shocks; the expected slope relative to b_P
ademp.methods: the analyst pipeline of the application: R_A transform, relative loss, gamma FGLS affine fit, b_P plug-in, within-state slope, week centring, affine-minus-power score contrast
ademp.performance_measures: Monte Carlo mean with MC SE (sd/sqrt(n)); 2.5 and 97.5% Monte Carlo limits with bootstrap MC SEs (500 resamples of the replicates); ratio of means for recovery ratios; the quantile of the observed value among simulated values with binomial MC SE; interval coverage in ma_coverage.json
ademp.replicates: 200 panels per generator (thinning 100 x 20, rho x k grid 100 per cell, baselines 200); seeds fixed per generator stream

meta.design: real R_A rows; shared counts; run paths carried by the true growth factors and level-anchored to the geometric mean of the observed counts of each run; global scale lambda per generator sets the mean median retained D to 45 (50 panels, rng [SEED,50,si]); heterogeneity recalibrated so the MC mean of fitted a equals observed a (40 panels, rng [SEED,51,si]); analyst scale D = simulated C_t, filter C_t >= 5
meta.superseded: first-round audit (run-start anchoring, no lambda) kept in analysis/superseded/; not used
